{{Quote|You'll have plenty of light, if it is a Coway passage. Take my word for it, boy.|Halla|<ref name="SotME" />}}
'''Coway shafts''' were underground tunnels used by the [[Coway]] to travel beneath the surface of [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]]. They were well-lit with [[Phosphorescent moss|phosphorescent growths]]. The Coway would often connect these tunnels to existing [[Thrella well]]s for surface access. They did not bother to hide their egresses to the surface. The Coway shafts could be quite extensive, including underground rivers and lakes, and large chambers that could house entire tribes of Coway numbering in the hundreds.

[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and their companions [[Halla]], [[Hin]], and [[Kee (Yuzzem)|Kee]] found themselves in a Coway shaft at the mercy of a local Coway tribe while attempting to discover the [[Kaiburr crystal]] in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]]. They later assisted the tribe in fighting off an invasion of their Coway shaft by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]
